latest_release.body:
## 2026.11.2

### Highlights

- **Privacy and trust boundaries:** Keep configuration secrets, conversation content, tool errors, and channel payloads out of diagnostic logs, enforce the selected provider and navigation trust boundaries, and release MCP grants after warm CLI turns. (#191318) (#174998) (#174544) (#172963) (#174526) (#173422) (#191748) (#191271) (#193438) (#191102) (#191980) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @wangmiao0668000666, @Finn763, @pgondhi987, @SebTardif, and @vincentkoc.
- **Account-safe delivery:** Preserve sender and account identity across durable retries and scheduled delivery, recover WhatsApp identity lookup, and retain Teams routing and allowlist settings across reloads. (#191819) (#193052) (#187637) (#186709) (#186334) Thanks @vincentkoc, @YangManBOBO, @yousan, and @nxmxbbd.
- **Gateway availability:** Reduce diagnostic capture work and avoid blocking the Gateway on plugin cleanup or pathological Telegram tables; cancel channel startup during shutdown and recover transient schema-lease conflicts. (#186666) (#180957) (#191675) (#183217) (#193452) (#191882) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @651juan, @amittell, @hannesrudolph, @zhangguiping-xydt, @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
- **Safer recovery and updates:** Preserve configured plugin executables and environment references through updates, repair macOS service recovery when Trash access is denied, and avoid update self-fencing and interrupted-update hangs. (#191693) (#193074) (#189321) (#193431) (#193263) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @sukhdeepjohar.
- **Native client recovery:** Keep iOS reconnect navigation responsive, preserve Android chat startup state, and recover Apple model and computer-use resources after transient initialization failures. (#191560) (#177347) (#191965) (#192001) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @TameTheGame, and @vincentkoc.
- **Installation and state correctness:** Restore browser-extension installation with Ubuntu’s default permissions, handle Windows state-directory casing, and preserve database ownership when reserving worktree capacity or recording authentication failures. (#186782) (#185917) (#192537) (#189901) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @javiermv, @YangManBOBO, @galiniliev, and @etzelm.

### Changes

- Optional diagnostic content capture now bounds attribute and candidate payload sizes and omits oversized image data, reducing diagnostic payload fidelity to protect Gateway responsiveness; this does not limit prompts or conversation history.

### Fixes

- **Model routing and providers:** Respect disabled reasoning, tier-suffixed settings, aliases, catalog readiness, quota reset periods, and provider request context; retain OpenCode Go models during endpoint outages. (#174156) (#170589) (#177340) (#176471) (#175898) (#172231) (#172711) (#193234) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @EmeraldPi, @huyengiang101086-spec, @abacha, @galiniliev, @fhgffy, @1052326311, and @theimmortal68.
- **Codex and Claude integrations:** Preserve imported sign-ins, refresh inherited workspace edits, keep native threads across proxy restarts, avoid unnecessary startup refreshes, and preserve permission mode and login-marker boundaries. (#178268) (#191439) (#177110) (#172727) (#177677) (#178193) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @potoior, @mnowrot, @Oldrich333, @Kimiyu-186, @sunlit-deng, and @eliavb43.
- **Memory and embeddings:** Bound assembled recall context, accept the memory-search limit alias, and forward the Azure OpenAI embedding API version correctly. (#110898) (#172630) (#139436) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joeykrug, @wr-web, @beebee, @LiuwqGit, @obviyus, and @OliPlus.

detail.readme_excerpt:
# OpenClaw 🦞 — Your assistant, on your devices, in your chats

OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant that runs on your own computer and meets you in the channels you already use: Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp, and 20+ more, plus native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, and Linux. One Gateway runs it as a personal claw on a laptop or as a shared [multiplayer claw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/start/multiplayer); configuration is the only difference. **Yours, with no catch.** State, memory, and credentials live on your hardware. Models and agent harnesses (Claude, Codex, local models) are plugins you can swap without changing anything else. Your prompts go to the model provider and chat platforms you configure, plus any diagnostics export you enable yourself; by default OpenClaw itself phones home for nothing but a daily version check, anonymous feature statistics are opt-in, and `update.checkOnStart: false` disables both ([what OpenClaw sends](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/telemetry)). OpenClaw is stewarded by the [OpenClaw Foundation](https://openclaw.org), an independent 501(c)(3), and has no paid tier, hosted service, or token. The architecture case — trusted gateway, untrusted execution, policy enforced by code — is in [Why OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/start/why-openclaw).
